entry.title: Towards New Self-Custody Best Practices
entry.summary: The importance of recovery rehearsals in cryptocurrency wallet management cannot be overstated. Even with enhancements that simplify the backup process, it's crucial for users to engage in recovery rehearsals. These rehearsals provide an opportunity to identify and rectify any missing information or misunderstandings before the wallet begins to handle significant sums of money. Ensuring that all aspects of wallet recovery are well-understood and correctly implemented can prevent potential losses in the future. Such rehearsals serve as a critical step in confirming the effectiveness of the backup system and the user’s understanding of it.
